baseline.observation: Initial x86 security boot panicked at final flood.stop with OperationDrainTimedOut after both application scopes retired. Generic error does not distinguish lease/IPC/memory cleanup. Historical failure remains unresolved, distinct from the new assertion failures.

implementation.owner: Existing ClosingAddressSpace carries one inline Option<PendingClose>; no allocating snapshot, new root/pin, registry, family or custody. Copy diagnostic fields have no cleanup/Drop behavior.
implementation.lease_observation: Same table hold as exact table/generation-validated rejected preflight. Counts are diagnostic, not permission to finish/release any lease.
implementation.ipc_observation: Selected under existing IPC read hold before cancellation preparation: token/call, captured caller/server roots, claim epoch, completing/cleanup_failed and loan count. Preparation may observe a changed/vanished episode or reject peer admission; this earlier selected sample is not a live claim proof. Missing identity stays None.
implementation.memory_observation: Actual Pending return under existing object registry: selected object, object/authority phase, transfer/revocation flags and retirement/DMA/copy pin counts.
implementation.logging: First explicit supervisor terminal observation logs captured root ID/generation, error and last Pending while closing owner remains live and local lifecycle/table/subsystem guards have left. Then existing abandonment retains complete owner/fence. Cached failure neither logs nor retries. No logging or callbacks added to Drop.
implementation.policy: Five-second reclamation deadline, original charges, typed subsystem completion, root sealing/invalidation/physical destruction and existing terminal retention unchanged. No new IRQ change, root lookup/adoption, physical retry or cleanup authority.
implementation.source_boundaries: Inline owner wrappers intentionally permit large enum variants to avoid allocation admission while fenced or registry relinking. Outer caller/destructor contexts remain separately qualified. Last observation can be stale; None proves neither absence nor quiescence.

controls.root_operations: Successive Pending polls sample two, then one exact root leases; retained backing, fenced new admission, old completion and exact-generation reuse remain asserted.
controls.ipc_abandonment: Exact selected token/call, both captured roots, epoch 1 and completing true after complete cancellation owner abandonment. Both roots/claim stay retained.
controls.memory_revocation: Unmapped authority reports Revoking and one retirement pin, no transfer/DMA/copy pin; exact object matches retained cap. Existing owner completion alone permits remaining namespace close.
controls.terminal_retention: Existing zero-budget fixture logs InitialOperations with one lease; cached errors preserve root, original charges and deployment failure counters after lease release. This deliberate failure is not the historical runtime timeout.
